Questions: "Does the geographic distribution of recorded killer whale (Orcinus orca) occurrences remain consistent across multiple years during the same season?"
- Null hypothesis (H₀): There is no significant difference in the geographic distribution of recorded orca occurrences between years during the same season.
- Alternative hypothesis (H₁): The geographic distribution of recorded orca occurrences differs between years during the same season.


```{r}
# load in packages
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(robis)
library(lubridate)
library(maps)
```

```{r}
# clean and validate
# Convert eventDate into a standard date format
orcas_clean <- orcas %>%
  mutate(
    observation_date = as.Date(
      substr(eventDate, 1, 10),
      format = "%Y-%m-%d"
    ),
    year = year(observation_date),
    month = month(observation_date)
  )
```

```{r}
# Examine converted dates
## not included - entire chunck
head(orcas_clean %>%
       select(eventDate, observation_date, year, month))

# Check missing dates
sum(is.na(orcas_clean$observation_date))

# Check date range
range(orcas_clean$observation_date, na.rm = TRUE)

# Count observations per year
orcas_clean %>%
  count(year, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Count observations per year

yearly_counts <- orcas_clean %>%

  count(year)

# Visualise annual occurrence records
ggplot(yearly_counts, aes(x = year, y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Annual Killer Whale Occurrence Records",
    subtitle = "OBIS occurrence dataset",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of records"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```


```{r}
# Count observations by year and month (2015–2026)
## not included - entire chunck
year_month_counts <- orcas_clean %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(year),
    !is.na(month),
    year >= 2015,
    year <= 2025
  ) %>%
  count(year, month)

# Create a heatmap
ggplot(year_month_counts,
       aes(x = factor(month),
           y = factor(year),
           fill = n)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    name = "Observations"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Seasonal Distribution of Killer Whale Records (2015–2025)",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Year"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

```{r}
# Visualise global occurrence records
## not included - entire chunck
ggplot(orcas_clean,

  ) +

```

1. Define the spatial research question
Research question: Does the global spatial distribution of recorded killer whale occurrences during summer remain consistent between 2015 and 2026?

Hypotheses
- H₀: The geographic distribution of recorded killer whale occurrences during summer does not differ substantially between years.
- H₁: The geographic distribution of recorded killer whale occurrences during summer changes between years.
One important decision: because summer occurs at different times in each hemisphere, define it as:
- Northern Hemisphere summer: June, July, August.
- Southern Hemisphere summer: December, January, February.

```{r}
# standardize summer: Southern Hemisphere summer crosses two calendar years. For example, December 2015–February 2016 is the 2015/16 summer. We will label it 2015, so it can be compared with Northern Hemisphere summer 2015.


orcas_summer <- orcas_clean %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(observation_date),
    !is.na(decimalLatitude),
    !is.na(decimalLongitude),
    between(year, 2015, 2026)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    hemisphere = if_else(
      decimalLatitude >= 0,
      "Northern",
      "Southern"
    ),

    summer_year = case_when(
      hemisphere == "Northern" ~ year,
      hemisphere == "Southern" & month == 12 ~ year,
      hemisphere == "Southern" & month %in% c(1, 2) ~ year - 1,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    (hemisphere == "Northern" & month %in% 6:8) |
    (hemisphere == "Southern" & month %in% c(12, 1, 2)),
    !is.na(summer_year),
    between(summer_year, 2015, 2025)
  )

# Built following Workshop 4 custom function standards to summarize annual metrics
summarise_orca_summer <- function(data_df, target_hemisphere) {
  # Safety check: ensure valid hemisphere argument is passed using stop()[cite: 90]
  if (!target_hemisphere %in% c("Northern", "Southern")) {
    stop("Error: target_hemisphere must be either 'Northern' or 'Southern'.")
  }
  
  data_df %>%
    filter(hemisphere == target_hemisphere) %>%
    group_by(summer_year) %>%
    summarise(
      record_count = n(),
      mean_latitude = mean(decimalLatitude, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_longitude = mean(decimalLongitude, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

# Test the custom function for both hemispheres
northern_summary <- summarise_orca_summer(orcas_summer, "Northern")
southern_summary <- summarise_orca_summer(orcas_summer, "Southern")

print("Northern Hemisphere Summer Summary:")
print(head(northern_summary))




#check summer records
#orcas_summer %>%
 # count(summer_year, hemisphere)

# nrow(orcas_summer)
```
summer filter has retained 13,036 occurrence records across 2015–2026
- Northern Hemisphere records are consistently higher than Southern Hemisphere records.
- Records increase substantially in 2024 and 2025.
- Southern Hemisphere records are particularly low in 2020, with only 19 records.

```{r}
# 3. Next step: create annual spatial maps
#create world map
world_map <- map_data("world")

#Northern hemi summer records plot
ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(
    data = world_map,
    aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
    fill = "grey95",
    colour = "grey80",
    linewidth = 0.1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = filter(orcas_summer, hemisphere == "Northern", between(summer_year, 2015, 2025)),
    aes(
      x = decimalLongitude,
      y = decimalLatitude
    ),
      colour = "steelblue",
    alpha = 0.5,
    size = 0.6
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ summer_year, ncol = 3) +
  coord_quickmap() +
  labs(
    title = "Northern Hemisphere Summer Orca Occurrences",
    subtitle = "Faceted small multiples (June–August, 2015–2025)",
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11)
  )



#southern hemi summer records plot
ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(
    data = world_map,
    aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
    fill = "grey90",
    colour = "grey70",
    linewidth = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = filter(
      orcas_summer,
      hemisphere == "Northern",
      summer_year <= 2025
    ),
    aes(
      x = decimalLongitude,
      y = decimalLatitude,
      colour = factor(summer_year)
    ),
    alpha = 0.5,
    size = 0.8
  ) +
  coord_quickmap() +
  labs(
    title = "Northern Hemisphere Summer Killer Whale Occurrences",
    subtitle = "June–August, 2015–2025",
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude",
    colour = "Summer year"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


```

```{r}
# combine maps
# Combined Map 1: Both hemispheres, all years (2015–2025) on a single map
ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(
    data = world_map,
    aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
    fill = "grey90",
    colour = "grey70",
    linewidth = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = filter(orcas_summer, between(summer_year, 2015, 2025)),
    aes(
      x = decimalLongitude,
      y = decimalLatitude,
      colour = factor(summer_year)
    ),
    alpha = 0.5,
    size = 0.7
  ) +
  coord_quickmap() +
  labs(
    title = "Global Summer Killer Whale Occurrences (Both Hemispheres)",
    subtitle = "Combined records across Northern (Jun–Aug) and Southern (Dec–Feb) summers, 2015–2025",
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude",
    colour = "Summer year"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14)
  )

# Combined Map 2: Faceted small multiples showing both hemispheres per year
ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(
    data = world_map,
    aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group),
    fill = "grey95",
    colour = "grey80",
    linewidth = 0.1
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = filter(orcas_summer, between(summer_year, 2015, 2025)),
    aes(
      x = decimalLongitude,
      y = decimalLatitude,
      colour = hemisphere
    ),
    alpha = 0.6,
    size = 0.7
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ summer_year, ncol = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Northern" = "skyblue", "Southern" = "lightblue")) +
  coord_quickmap() +
  labs(
    title = "Global Summer Orca Occurrences by Year",
    subtitle = "Faceted small multiples (Both hemispheres, 2015–2025)",
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude",
    colour = "Hemisphere"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```
